name: @eidandev/connections-kit
description: eidan connections kit (matbot): shared engine-side machinery for BYO-client OAuth integrations — a per-plugin account registry over plugin_<name>.accounts (multi-account, optional per-host), the OAuth protocol skeleton + per-platform adapter interface, a server-side connect/reconnect HTTP server behind the AG-UI panel-proxy, per-account vault key derivation, transparent token refresh, and a SocialConnections lookup so Charles can validate a connected handle. Consumed by google and the social-* plugins.
